significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish that an identifiable circuit integrates “commitment and verification-completion signals,” uses a systematically late stop threshold, and exhibits a “difficulty-dependent optimal threshold.” This combines a form-(ii) causal mechanism with a limited form-(iii) dependence: it predicts that readiness should precede stopping, that lowering the threshold should remove avoidable tokens, and that harder problems should require a larger protective margin; this matters specifically because s1 (Muennighoff et al., 2025) controls reasoning length through external budget forcing rather than an interpretable readiness variable. It establishes both a late-stopping phenomenon and a mechanistic explanation; a negative result would rule out the proposed unified threshold account, although the conjunction of several subclaims would leave ambiguity about which part failed. True and false are distinguishable, and after topic substitution the generic efficient-reasoning topic would not retain this score because the commitment/verification decomposition and difficulty-threshold relation—not the topic’s general importance—supply the additional constraint.

reach.justification: The transferable handles are the claimed “stop-readiness signal,” “internal stop threshold,” and resulting “calibrated efficiency knob.” These operate ex ante during generation: readiness can trigger termination before excess tokens are produced, giving model deployers an action window rather than merely explaining an already completed trace. After per-model re-extraction, the claim predicts the qualitative relation that late stopping reflects a safety margin and that the optimal threshold depends on difficulty, but it supplies no quantitative scaling law; scope is also limited to “models with explicit thinking delimiters” and may vary by training recipe. The topic-substitution check lowers the case from broader impact bands: efficient reasoning alone supplies no deployable handle, whereas this specific threshold knob could be used by researchers and practitioners who gate or ship reasoning systems.
